authentication: Use a private Make Apify connection; no token is included in this recipe.
batching: Aggregate the entire bounded input list into exactly one bundle before the paid API call. Stop if input is empty, too long, duplicated or contains YOUR_ placeholders.
output_handling: Match each domain back to its source row; preserve zero/false and leave missing signals blank. Do not change source domain keys during the run.
error_handling: Stop on errors or HTTP timeout. Do not retry the paid call or create a polling loop that starts new runs; inspect the existing run in Apify Console first.
validation: Input types/fields match the local Actor schema. Native Make import and live operation have not been tested.
